name: Summer Art Camp: Teen Art Week
org: Sidney and Lois Eskenazi Museum of Art, Indiana University
what_you_do: A week-long museum art camp for teens. You sketch in the galleries, look closely at artworks, and make drawing, painting and mixed media projects.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page
duration: 1 week, noon to 3 p.m. Monday to Friday (July 27 to 31 in 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 teen week is full. The page says registration for each camp opens on the museum calendar; 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a class. Use the events calendar at the Eskenazi Museum.
notes: The 2026 camp was full. Younger weeks are for ages 7 to 12. Contact the museum for cost.
